Laminas Packages
================
Vendor packages from the Laminas project bundled for laminas-mail.

Contents
--------
- laminas-loader – autoloading utilities.
- laminas-mime – MIME message utilities.
- laminas-servicemanager – service container and plugin managers.
- laminas-stdlib – general-purpose utilities.
- laminas-validator – validation components.

Notes
-----
- Each subpackage includes its own upstream README and license; refer there for details.
- Treat as vendor code; update via Composer when upgrading laminas-mail.
